Get Started with OpenCode on Mac: A Free AI Coding Agent

Want free access to powerful AI frontier models for your coding projects ? OpenCode is a free, open-source coding agent that runs directly in your terminal. Here is how to get it running in 5 simple steps.

## Step 1: Install Homebrew

If you do not have Homebrew installed on your Mac, go to [brew.sh](https://brew.sh), copy the installation command, and run it inside your terminal:

```bash
/bin/bash -c "$(curl -fsSL https://raw.githubusercontent.com/Homebrew/install/HEAD/install.sh)"
```

Verify the installation by running `brew -v`.

## Step 2: Install OpenCode

Head over to the documentation page at [opencode.ai/docs](https://opencode.ai/docs) and use the recommended Homebrew installation command:

```bash
brew install anomalyco/tap/opencode
```

## Step 3: Generate an OpenCode Zen API Key

To access the AI models, navigate to the [OpenCode Zen](https://opencode.ai/docs/zen) settings portal. Sign in using your Google or GitHub account, head to the **API Keys** section, click **Create API Key**, and copy the newly generated key.

## Step 4: Connect OpenCode to the Provider

Launch the tool by typing `opencode` into your terminal. Once open, enter the command:

```text
/connect
```

Select the **OpenCode Zen (Recommended)** provider from the menu, paste your API key, and hit enter.

## Step 5: Pick a Free Model and Code

Scroll through the available models. Free frontier models are explicitly marked as "Free" (such as *Nemotron 3 Ultra Free*). Select your preferred option, type a quick message like "Hi" to confirm the agent responds, and start coding!
